triage_method: Conservative name/lexical triage only. This is a queue classifier, not identity proof and not canonical state.
rules: Exact canonical identity requires primary/native evidence.
Execution-plane labels are not merged automatically.
Alias candidates require primary identity evidence.
DEX presence does not imply flash liquidity, executable routes, liquidity-at-size, profitability or authorization.
High-information labels may be promoted only after current official primary evidence; promotion does not infer execution capability.
Cosmos Hub, Sui and Starknet were promoted only from official primary evidence; promotion does not infer flash liquidity or execution.

Astar zkEVM is treated as a historical/superseded execution-plane label because Astar officially transitioned the zkEVM initiative to Soneium; it is not promoted as a current independent canonical production network from the stale label.
reconciliation_findings: Official ZKsync mainnet table currently lists 12 mainnet chains; ecosystem identity must not replace per-chain canonical identities.
execution_eligibility_boundary: Labels without primary identity proof remain discovery/quarantine and are excluded from execution eligibility.
